spec.title: Exporter Poll Lag
spec.description: Time since the exporter's last successful poll. A high or climbing value means it has stalled or is failing to reach Postgres.

spec.title: Estimated Cost
spec.description: Sum of estimated cost across all users and models. See the exporter's pricing file for the currency this is denominated in.
